newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine central bank currency reserves $3.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine central bank currency reserves $3.3 bln.

text.p: The National Bank of Ukraine's (NBU) hard currency reserves grew to $3.3 billion as of January 15 this year from $2.0 billion at the end of 1995, the chief of the bank's foreign currency reserves department said on Tuesday.
"In 1993, when we started working, the central bank had a zero balance as far as hard currency and gold reserves went," Mykola Melnychuk told Reuters.

He said the central bank could only afford to buy gold from Ukrainians at present, but planned to begin a gold exploration and mining programme this year. --Natalya Zinets, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
